name: North/South
reveals: Whether the real flag is N or S of the fixed midline for the enemy team's full candidate pool

name: East/West
reveals: Whether the real flag is E or W of the enemy team's home base

name: Eliminate One
reveals: Names one of the 5 candidate landmarks that is not the real flag

name: Eliminate Two
reveals: Names two candidate landmarks that are not the real flag

name: Decoy Reveal
reveals: Names one of the two decoys (does not reveal real)

name: Hot/Cold
reveals: Purchase-time distance bracket from your current GPS to real flag (<200 m / <500 m / <1 km / further)

name: Surroundings
reveals: One photo of the surroundings within 30 m of the real flag, no marker visible

name: Direction
reveals: Broad compass direction from city center to real flag (N / E / S / W)
